headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: AP Local Body Polls Largely Peaceful, Sporadic Violence Reported In Panchayat Polls.
Panchayat Polls: Chittoor Records 82.40% Turnout, Tirupati 70.56%.
Show Cause Notice Issued To 280 Staff Absent From Election Duty.
Workers of BJP, JD(S) stage protest opposing Operation Gaja at Kadabagere in Chikkamagaluru.
Bengaluru: Forum launches indefinite protest against school adoption scheme.
bullets_ur: AP ke local body intikhabat zyadatar puramn rahay, panchayat polls mein kahin kahin tashadud ki khabar.
Panchayat Polls: Chittoor mein 82.40% aur Tirupati mein 70.56% voting record ki gayi.
Election duty se ghair hazir 280 staff ko show cause notice jari kar diye gaye.
Chikkamagaluru ke Kadabagere mein BJP aur JD(S) karkunon ne Operation Gaja ke khilaf ehtijaj kiya.
Bengaluru: Forum ne school adoption scheme ke khilaf ghair moayyan muddat ke ehtijaj ka aaghaz kar diya.
